name_zh: 虚构：超强台风「天枢」千年一遇复合事件（2032-09-14）
name_en: Fictional: Super Typhoon Dubhe, 1-in-1000-year compound event (14 Sep 2032)
narrative_zh: 【虚构情景】一个比山竹更强、路径更不利（在香港西南 30 公里掠过）的超强台风，在天文大潮高潮时登陆，并叠加 0.3 米海平面上升：鲗鱼涌潮位达约 5.3 米（海图基准面），吐露港约 6.6 米；同时带来超越 2023 年黑雨的千年一遇暴雨（时雨量 220 毫米、24 小时约 1050 毫米）。用于压力测试维港填海区及现有防洪设施。
narrative_en: [Fictional] A super typhoon stronger than Mangkhut on a worse track (30 km southwest of Hong Kong), landing at spring high tide with 0.3 m of sea-level rise: ~5.3 m CD at Quarry Bay and ~6.6 m CD in Tolo Harbour, combined with a 1-in-1000-year rainstorm exceeding 2023 (220 mm/h, ~1050 mm in 24 h). A stress test for reclaimed land and existing defences.
facts: 鲗鱼涌设计潮位 Quarry Bay
≈ 5.3 m CD (surge 2.6 m + spring HW + 0.3 m SLR)
sources: Scenario design by this project; surge/rain magnitudes chosen relative to HKO records
